principle: Each stage consumes a hashed PASS artifact from the preceding stage; no stage may infer missing scientific values or bypass a HOLD.

stages.name: clean_slab_convergence
stages.input: hashed bulk handoff and full bulk result
required_checks: surface excess domination tolerance <= 1.0 meV per surface atom
fit residual and slab-slope diagnostics reported

stages.name: na_pseudopotential_validation
stages.input: SSSP v2 PBE-efficiency archive and Cu method handoff
required_checks: exact archive path and SHA-256 recorded
Na UPF identity and SHA-256 recorded
mixed-system cutoffs equal componentwise maximum registered recommendations

stages.name: adsorption_site_screening
required_checks: coverage and supercell frozen before energies
hollow bridge and top starts included
same electrostatic convention for all sites

stages.name: climbing_image_neb
required_checks: climbing image enabled only after ordinary NEB convergence

stages.name: saddle_verification
required_checks: forward and reverse downhill connectivity verified

stages.name: barrier_coordinate_extraction
required_checks: zero-point or thermal corrections separated from electronic barrier
unsupported friction or linewidth quantities left null

stages.name: atlas_admission
stages.input: PASS barrier coordinate and verified public kinetic evidence where available
required_checks: same system phase and temperature enforced
numeric barrier and rate provenance recorded
computed and experimental columns kept distinct

stages.name: integration_readiness
stages.input: all available PASS and HOLD artifacts
required_checks: no HOLD converted to PASS by narrative judgment

experimental_only_gaps: direct experimental diffusion rate if no qualified public numeric source exists
system-specific friction or linewidth not derivable from the registered calculations
independent physical replication outside the computational workflow
